runtime_target_transport: none: offline, scripted models, no audio and no transport
provider_model_settings: pydantic-ai FunctionModel; ALLOW_MODEL_REQUESTS=False, so a real provider request raises rather than being made
command_or_scenario_recipe: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 GOOGLE_API_KEY=offline-test-placeholder .venv/bin/python -B -c 'import sys, runpy; import pydantic_ai.models as models; models.ALLOW_MODEL_REQUESTS = False; runpy.run_module(sys.argv[1], run_name="__main__")' tests.test_state
expected: The historical short number is refused before lookup; valid, split, corrected, withheld and wrong-readback cases behave
actual: +348340464 is refused by the field validator, so confirm_customer never runs and no customer lookup happens. A bare 600111222 is refused rather than completed to +34. A valid +1 number is refused with a distinguishable "not from a supported region" message. A caller agreeing to a wrong readback yields a valid, confirmed, looked-up state -- and three separate fields keep structural validity from reading as identity.
limitations: Offline and scripted. No real provider accepted these schemas, no audio was synthesised or recognised, and no carrier was involved. Nothing here transfers to a live call.
Spain only, by deliberate policy. Other countries are a clarification path, not a supported case, and this proves nothing about them.
A valid number is not proof of ownership. The wrong-readback case records that risk rather than removing it.
